coverage_note: Mosaico completo de la cobertura IGN disponible sobre el entorno del consorcio, sin recorte al polígono.
image_note: Imported by src/components/map2d/map2dUtils.ts, so Vite emits it to /assets/<name>-<hash>.webp and it inherits the 1-year immutable rule in public/_headers. Resized to 4000px wide (PERF): the 6318px original blew past MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE=4096 on mobile GPUs.
